title: Tofu provider offering recipe v1
description: A first-run onboarding recipe for one provider account. Logical identity is model_id; provider wire spellings belong in request_ids. The full application imports the staged result into model-routing v2.

category.description: Official means a model developer's own API; relay means a third-party inference host, aggregator or gateway, not an endorsement.

catalog_mode.description: Discovery templates may be connection-only; model availability must be discovered with the owner's credential.

catalog_source.description: Provenance of the authored endpoint/seed list, not proof of account entitlement or a live probe. Never refreshed merely by reading a template.

retired_model_ids.description: Authored kill-switch: logical model ids the dynamic template feed (lib/provider/provider_template_feed.py) must never re-add to this template.

model_id.description: Exact logical model identity shared across providers.

request_ids.description: Provider wire ids tried for this logical model.

request_faces.description: Per-wire face override: {wire id: face name}. Absent means the entry's own face (or the family rule) applies to every wire id. Needed when a gateway serves one spelling only through a specific provider selector, while the logical model's other spellings use the default face.
